verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Skyvern handles logins end-to-end with stored credentials, TOTP/authenticator codes, email/SMS verification, and magic links. They also describe password-manager integrations with Bitwarden, 1Password, and Azure Key Vault, which covers the vault and 2FA core of the story. One community comment worries about credentials being handled in plain text, but it is general concern rather than a concrete failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that secrets are kept out of the LLM's context, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vault-backed TOTP logins.
